mentions.name: Valuate.dev
mentions.description: An AI-first interview platform for developers that designs coding challenges combining prompting and coding. It scores both how well a candidate's prompts align with the task and the quality of the resulting LLM-generated code, aiming to measure AI prompting skills, while keeping a human-first balance in the hiring process.
mentions.problem: The usual approach to coding interview tasks no longer works: companies are looking for AI engineers, but it is still unclear how to assess AI proficiency.
mentions.audience: Companies hiring developers; developers being assessed
